source_findings.finding: Codex app work emphasizes multi-agent supervision, long-running work, skills, automations, sandboxing, and continuity across app and CLI surfaces.
source_findings.application: Treat watcher-supervised sibling runtime as normal operating mode and use wait windows for synthesis and x2 build preparation.

source_findings.finding: The release includes app-server v2 remote-control RPCs, plugin JSON surfaces, multi-agent metadata improvements, and Windows sandbox refresh reliability work.
source_findings.application: Keep direct app-server fallback, machine-readable receipts, and sandbox readiness metadata as first-class THOS design inputs.

source_findings.finding: Google frames agent systems around build, scale, and govern pillars: ADK/framework support, managed runtime, memory/session state, evaluation, identity, observability, registry, and runtime protection.
source_findings.application: Map THOS helper runners to build/scale/govern lanes: launcher design, watcher runtime, status registry, and safety/evidence gates.

source_findings.finding: NIM packages production-grade inference microservices with security updates, deployment paths, Kubernetes/GKE support, and blueprints for RAG, research agents, and data flywheels.
source_findings.application: Use NIM as a reference pattern for future THOS service packaging, lifecycle receipts, and model-serving boundary design.

source_findings.source: NVIDIA NIM for Large Language Models overview
source_findings.finding: NIM LLM 2.0 emphasizes predictable one-container, one-backend operation, validated runtimes, and lifecycle tradeoffs between day-zero model access and certified production packaging.
source_findings.application: Keep THOS helper runners modular: one helper, one responsibility, explicit lifecycle state, and no hidden cross-surface coupling.

source_findings.finding: Least authority, explicit consent, and confused-deputy avoidance are core principles for tool ecosystems.
source_findings.application: Keep app, CLI, connector, and repo mutation lanes separate, with exact receipt-backed boundaries.

source_findings.finding: Security logging should avoid sensitive data exposure and preserve useful, sanitized event evidence.
source_findings.application: Publish only status, hashes, counts, timestamps, gate outcomes, and sanitized summaries for sibling and helper runs.

x2_build_implications: Turn v4 direct app repair into a reusable build/scale/govern decision table for v5 x2.
Model THOS helper runners as one-responsibility microservices with explicit lifecycle states.
Add a machine-readable status registry row for watcher, notifier, repair, redactor, gate, and normalizer helpers.
Create a source-to-build trace from Codex, Google, NVIDIA, MCP, and OWASP findings to v5 x2 tasks.
Keep Arby and Aster Vale long-form evidence as temp-only raw output plus published counts and hashes.
Keep GMUT, canon, consciousness, and final-physics gates open unless exact closure artifacts prove otherwise.
